Text: 📍 Kuala Lumpur | Makanan halal sedap yang wajib try! Nasi lemak Village Park memang legend 🔥 Sambal dia perfect balance, ayam rendang juicy. Queue panjang but worth the wait! #halalfood #nasilemak #KL
Best halal dim sum in KL! 🥟 Yum Cha Chinatown serves authentic dim sum yang semua halal certified. Har gow, siu mai, char siu bao - everything taste amazing! #dimsum #halalfood #chinatown
Jalan Alor food hunt! 🍢 So many halal options - satay, char kway teow, rojak, cendol. The atmosphere at night is incredible. Perfect spot untuk foodie adventures! #jalanalor #streetfood #halal
Roti canai crispy perfection at Pelita Bangsar! 🥞 Their curry kambing is rich and flavorful. Open 24/7 so perfect untuk late night cravings. Teh tarik pun sedap! #roticanai #mamak #bangsar
Rebung Chef Ismail - fine dining Malay cuisine! 🍽️ Rendang tok melts in your mouth, gulai tempoyak is unique and delicious. Pricey but the quality is exceptional. #finedining #malaycuisine #rebung
Hidden gem alert! 💎 Warung Pak Su kat Kampung Baru serves authentic laksa Johor. Thick gravy, fresh ingredients, only RM8! Simple place but amazing food. #laksajohor #kampungbaru #hiddengem
Lamb mandi at Hadramout Restaurant! 🐑 The rice is so fragrant, lamb is tender and well-spiced. Authentic Middle Eastern flavors in the heart of Ampang. #lambmandi #middleeastern #ampang
Breakfast goals at Restoran Seri Melayu! 🌅 Their nasi lemak sambal is fire 🔥 Creamy santan, perfectly cooked rice. Great value for money and friendly service! #breakfast #nasilemak #serimelayu
Pasar malam vibes! 🌙 Taman Connaught Wednesday night market has amazing halal street food. Apam balik, rojak, fresh sugarcane juice. Family-friendly prices! #pasarmalam #streetfood #tamanconnaught
Seafood feast at Restoran Nelayan! 🦐 Butter prawns, salted egg crab, sweet sour fish - all halal and fresh. Great place untuk seafood lovers in Ampang area. #seafood #halal #ampang

Nostalgic flavors at Restoran Oversea! 🍗 Their Hainanese chicken rice has been perfected since 1960s. Tender chicken, fragrant rice, traditional taste that never gets old. #chickenrice #hainanese #imbi

Mee rebus heaven at Warung Apek! 🍜 Thick gravy loaded with flavor, generous toppings, student-friendly price RM6. Always packed during lunch - that's how you know it's good! #meerebus #setapak #studentfood

Sate perfection! 🍢 Sate Kajang Hj Samuri serves the most tender beef and chicken satay. Their peanut sauce is creamy and rich. Multiple locations around KL for your convenience! #satay #kajang #peanutSauce

Dining with a view! 🏙️ Seri Angkasa at KL Tower offers halal buffet with stunning city skyline. Food variety is decent, but the view is absolutely spectacular especially at night! #kltower #buffet #skyline

Traditional kopitiam experience! ☕ Petaling Street coffee shop serves strong kopi-o and perfect half-boiled eggs. Simple breakfast in authentic old-school atmosphere. #kopitiam #petalingstreet #traditional

Rare find in KL! 🍚 Nasi Dagang Terengganu at Wangsa Maju brings authentic East Coast flavors. Fish curry is rich, coconut rice aromatic. Worth the drive for this specialty! #nasidagang #terengganu #wangsamaju

Indian Muslim cuisine at its finest! 🍛 Restoran Kapitan's tandoori chicken and naan bread are absolutely delicious. Perfect spice level, authentic flavors. Great untuk Indian food cravings! #indianmuslim #tandoori #naan

Sweet treats at Secret Recipe! 🍰 Their chocolate indulgence cake is heavenly. All outlets are halal certified, consistent quality across branches. Perfect untuk celebrations! #secretrecipe #cake #chocolate

Upscale nasi lemak experience! 🍽️ Madam Kwan's serves premium nasi lemak with rendang chicken. Coconut rice is perfect, rendang rich in flavor. Pricey but generous portions! #madamkwans #nasilemak #upscale

Ramadan bazaar memories! 🌙 Jalan TAR bazar has incredible variety - kuih tradisional, murtabak, fresh sugarcane juice. Reasonable prices, good quality. Perfect untuk berbuka shopping! #ramadanbazar #jalantAR #berbuka
